user.title: SHiP Anchor — Step 1 of 5: Direction
user.description: SHiP Anchor now lets you start from EITHER end. Pick the device you already know about — the thing you want to CONTROL (a light, fan, valve, lock), or the switch/button you want to USE. The wizard then walks you to the other end and (optionally) through an intermediate canopy module.

source.title: SHiP Anchor — Step 2 of 5: Source
source.description: Pick the switch(es) / button(s) — {count} compatible device(s) speak the {protocol} protocol. Pick one, or several for a multi-way (3-way) setup.

target.title: SHiP Anchor — Step 2 of 5: Target
target.description: Pick the light(s), fan, valve, lock or shade you want to CONTROL — {count} compatible device(s) speak the {protocol} protocol. 3+ targets automatically use a group binding.

behavior.title: SHiP Anchor — Step 3 of 5: Behaviour
behavior.description: Build the rule sheet: for each tap/hold pick a gesture, an optional time window (start → end hour), and the action {target_count} target(s) should take. These become LEAT rows on the hardware, so they keep working with the hub offline.

data.rule1_color_temp_mireds: Rule 1 — colour temp mireds (153 warm → 500 cool, optional)

canopy.title: SHiP Anchor — Step 4 of 5: Intermediate Module (optional)
canopy.description: If the signal passes through a ceiling canopy, relay box, or mesh repeater before reaching the load, pick it here and SHiP Anchor will build a two-hop chain:  source → canopy → target.  Leave empty for a direct one-hop binding. {canopy_count} compatible device(s) speak the {protocol} protocol.

finish.title: SHiP Anchor — Step 5 of 5: Preview or Apply
finish.description: Review: {source} → {target_count} target(s) over {protocol}. Dry-run previews the payloads and LEAT rows in your log without touching any hardware.

data.dry_run: Dry run (preview only, do not send to devices)

error.direction_required: Pick a direction — start from the thing you want to control, or from the switch/button you want to use.
error.canopy_not_found: That canopy device is no longer in your device registry. Please pick another one, or leave the field empty for a direct binding.
error.source_not_found: That source device is no longer in your device registry. Please pick another one.
error.source_required: Pick at least one source switch. If none are listed, your source and target may speak different protocols.
error.target_required: Pick at least one target device, or enable 'Use a group' and give the group a name.
error.rule_required: Set a gesture on at least one rule (1x–5x tap or Hold) before continuing.

abort.restart_wizard: Opening the setup wizard again. Pick the source, targets and behaviour to re-apply this binding.
